name: BMP388 pressure & temperature sensor
description: Bosch high-precision digital barometric pressure (300–1250 hPa, ±0.08 hPa relative, ±0.5 hPa absolute) and temperature (-40 to +85 °C, ±0.5 °C) sensor with I2C and SPI interfaces. The chip runs on 1.65–3.6 V. Sold as: Adafruit BMP388 Precision Barometric Pressure and Altimeter breakout, STEMMA QT version (#3966), 8-pin header VIN, 3Vo, GND, SCL, SDO, SDA, CS, INT (3.3 V regulator and level shifting, 3–5 V supply), I2C address 0x77 (0x76 with SDO tied to GND or the ADDR jumper shorted).
eli5: A very sensitive barometer and thermometer: it feels tiny changes in air pressure, enough to notice you lifting it by a stair step, and also reads the temperature.

pins.name: VIN
pins.description: Supply, 3–5 V into the on-board 3.3 V regulator (use the same voltage as your board's logic)

pins.name: 3Vo
pins.description: 3.3 V output of the on-board regulator (up to 100 mA); not a supply input, leave unconnected

pins.name: SCL
pins.description: I2C clock (SPI SCK); 10 kΩ pull-up and level shifting on the board

pins.name: SDO
pins.description: I2C address select (SPI data out): open = 0x77 (10 kΩ pull-up to 3.3 V), GND = 0x76. 3.3 V only, not level shifted: never tie it to 5 V

pins.name: SDA
pins.description: I2C data (SPI SDI); 10 kΩ pull-up and level shifting on the board

pins.name: CS
pins.description: SPI chip select; pulled up on the board so the chip uses I2C. Leave unconnected for I2C

pins.name: INT
pins.description: Interrupt output (3.3 V push-pull, data ready / FIFO), not needed for basic use

supplierQuery: Adafruit BMP388 precision barometric pressure altimeter breakout 3966
buildNotes: Power VIN from your board's 3.3 V (or 5 V on a 5 V board); the on-board regulator feeds the chip 3.3 V. 3Vo is an output: leave it unconnected.
The default I2C address is 0x77 (SDO pulled high on the board). Tie SDO to GND, or short the ADDR jumper, for 0x76, e.g. for a second sensor.
Check the chip ID: register 0x00 reads 0x50 on a BMP388 (0x60 on a BMP390, which uses the same driver).
Raw readings mean nothing without the factory calibration in 0x31–0x45 and the datasheet appendix 9 formulas; compute temperature first, because pressure needs t_lin.
Data registers are little-endian (XLSB first) 24-bit values: read 0x04–0x09 in one burst after drdy_press and drdy_temp are set in STATUS (0x03).
Keep it out of drafts and direct sunlight, and away from the regulator: airflow shows up as pressure noise.

driver.code:
# MicroPython driver for the Bosch BMP388 pressure/temperature sensor (I2C)
# Written from Bosch datasheet BST-BMP388-DS001 rev 1.7:
#   register map sec. 4, trimming coefficients table 23 (sec. 3.11.1),
#   float compensation appendix 9 (9.1 coefficient scaling, 9.2 temperature, 9.3 pressure),
#   measurement time sec. 3.9.2.
# Also works on a BMP390 (chip id 0x60), which uses the same registers and formulas.
import time

REG_CHIP_ID = 0x00   # 0x50 on BMP388
REG_ERR = 0x02       # bit0 fatal_err, bit1 cmd_err, bit2 conf_err
REG_STATUS = 0x03    # bit4 cmd_rdy, bit5 drdy_press, bit6 drdy_temp
REG_DATA = 0x04      # 0x04..0x09: press xlsb/lsb/msb, temp xlsb/lsb/msb (24-bit unsigned, LSB first)
REG_PWR_CTRL = 0x1B  # bit0 press_en, bit1 temp_en, bits5:4 mode (00 sleep, 01 forced, 11 normal)
REG_OSR = 0x1C       # bits2:0 osr_p, bits5:3 osr_t (0=x1 ... 5=x32)
REG_ODR = 0x1D
REG_CONFIG = 0x1F    # bits3:1 IIR filter coefficient
REG_CALIB = 0x31     # 0x31..0x45: NVM_PAR_T1 .. NVM_PAR_P11 (21 bytes)
REG_CMD = 0x7E       # 0xB6 = softreset

CHIP_IDS = (0x50, 0x60)  # BMP388, BMP390


def _u16(b, i):
    return b[i] | (b[i + 1] << 8)


def _s16(b, i):
    v = _u16(b, i)
    return v - 65536 if v > 32767 else v


def _s8(b, i):
    v = b[i]
    return v - 256 if v > 127 else v


class BMP388:
    def __init__(self, i2c, addr=0x77, osr_p=3, osr_t=0):
        """addr 0x77 (SDO high, Adafruit default) or 0x76 (SDO to GND).
        osr codes: 0=x1, 1=x2, 2=x4, 3=x8, 4=x16, 5=x32 (table 41)."""
        self.i2c = i2c
        self.addr = addr
        cid = self._r(REG_CHIP_ID, 1)[0]
        if cid not in CHIP_IDS:
            raise OSError("BMP388 not found at 0x%02X (chip id 0x%02X, expected 0x50)" % (addr, cid))
        self._soft_reset()
        self._load_calib()
        self.osr_p = osr_p & 0x07
        self.osr_t = osr_t & 0x07
        self._w(REG_CONFIG, 0x00)  # IIR filter off
        self._w(REG_OSR, (self.osr_t << 3) | self.osr_p)
        self._w(REG_ODR, 0x00)
        self._w(REG_PWR_CTRL, 0x00)  # sleep until a forced measurement is requested
        self.t_lin = 0.0

    def _r(self, reg, n):
        return self.i2c.readfrom_mem(self.addr, reg, n)

    def _w(self, reg, val):
        self.i2c.writeto_mem(self.addr, reg, bytes([val & 0xFF]))

    def _soft_reset(self):
        # Wait until the command decoder is ready, then issue softreset (table 18 / sec. 4.3.22).
        for _ in range(20):
            if self._r(REG_STATUS, 1)[0] & 0x10:
                break
            time.sleep_ms(1)
        self._w(REG_CMD, 0xB6)
        time.sleep_ms(3)  # start-up time 2 ms max
        for _ in range(20):
            if self._r(REG_STATUS, 1)[0] & 0x10:
                break
            time.sleep_ms(1)
        if self._r(REG_ERR, 1)[0] & 0x02:
            raise OSError("BMP388 soft reset failed (cmd_err)")

    def _load_calib(self):
        c = self._r(REG_CALIB, 21)
        # Appendix 9.1: convert the NVM integers to floating-point coefficients.
        self.par_t1 = _u16(c, 0) / 2.0 ** -8
        self.par_t2 = _u16(c, 2) / 2.0 ** 30
        self.par_t3 = _s8(c, 4) / 2.0 ** 48
        self.par_p1 = (_s16(c, 5) - 2 ** 14) / 2.0 ** 20
        self.par_p2 = (_s16(c, 7) - 2 ** 14) / 2.0 ** 29
        self.par_p3 = _s8(c, 9) / 2.0 ** 32
        self.par_p4 = _s8(c, 10) / 2.0 ** 37
        self.par_p5 = _u16(c, 11) / 2.0 ** -3
        self.par_p6 = _u16(c, 13) / 2.0 ** 6
        self.par_p7 = _s8(c, 15) / 2.0 ** 8
        self.par_p8 = _s8(c, 16) / 2.0 ** 15
        self.par_p9 = _s16(c, 17) / 2.0 ** 48
        self.par_p10 = _s8(c, 19) / 2.0 ** 48
        self.par_p11 = _s8(c, 20) / 2.0 ** 65

    def _measure(self):
        # Forced mode with pressure and temperature enabled; the chip returns to sleep afterwards.
        self._w(REG_PWR_CTRL, 0x13)
        # Sec. 3.9.2: T_conv = 234 + (392 + 2^osr_p * 2000) + (313 + 2^osr_t * 2000) us
        t_us = 234 + 392 + (1 << self.osr_p) * 2000 + 313 + (1 << self.osr_t) * 2000
        time.sleep_ms(t_us // 1000 + 2)
        for _ in range(100):
            if (self._r(REG_STATUS, 1)[0] & 0x60) == 0x60:  # drdy_temp and drdy_press
                break
            time.sleep_ms(2)
        else:
            raise OSError("BMP388 measurement timed out")
        if self._r(REG_ERR, 1)[0] & 0x04:
            raise OSError("BMP388 configuration error (conf_err)")
        d = self._r(REG_DATA, 6)  # one burst read (sec. 3.10)
        adc_p = d[0] | (d[1] << 8) | (d[2] << 16)
        adc_t = d[3] | (d[4] << 8) | (d[5] << 16)
        return adc_t, adc_p

    def _comp_t(self, uncomp_temp):
        # Appendix 9.2; returns degC and keeps t_lin for the pressure formula.
        pd1 = uncomp_temp - self.par_t1
        pd2 = pd1 * self.par_t2
        self.t_lin = pd2 + (pd1 * pd1) * self.par_t3
        return self.t_lin

    def _comp_p(self, uncomp_press):
        # Appendix 9.3; returns Pa.
        t = self.t_lin
        out1 = self.par_p5 + self.par_p6 * t + self.par_p7 * (t * t) + self.par_p8 * (t * t * t)
        out2 = uncomp_press * (self.par_p1 + self.par_p2 * t + self.par_p3 * (t * t) + self.par_p4 * (t * t * t))
        up = float(uncomp_press)
        pd4 = up * up * (self.par_p9 + self.par_p10 * t) + (up * up * up) * self.par_p11
        return out1 + out2 + pd4

    def read(self):
        """Returns (temperature degC, pressure hPa)."""
        adc_t, adc_p = self._measure()
        t = self._comp_t(adc_t)  # must run first: sets t_lin
        p = self._comp_p(adc_p) / 100.0
        return t, p

    def temperature(self):
        return self.read()[0]

    def pressure(self):
        return self.read()[1]

    def altitude(self, sea_level_hpa=1013.25):
        """Approximate altitude in metres from the international barometric formula."""
        p = self.read()[1]
        return 44330.0 * (1.0 - (p / sea_level_hpa) ** (1 / 5.255))

example.code:
from machine import I2C, Pin
import time
from bmp388 import BMP388

i2c = I2C({I2C_ID}, sda=Pin({SDA}), scl=Pin({SCL}))
sensor = BMP388(i2c, addr=0x77)
while True:
    t, p = sensor.read()
    print('T=%.2fC P=%.2fhPa' % (t, p))
    time.sleep(1)
